title: BC Friday Tips #49 Page Scripting and AI
summary: Page Scripting records and replays steps in Business Central for automated testing. AI can convert these scripts into user documentation and training manuals, reducing manual writing effort.
key_points: Page Scripting records and replays user actions in Business Central
AI can transform Page Scripting scripts into end-user documentation
Recorded scripts serve dual purposes for both testing and user training
AI-generated content can include diagrams for better documentation clarity

quotes.text: Page Scripting is a powerful tool that records and replays your steps in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core capability of Page Scripting for recording user workflows

quotes.text: AI can turn a Page Scripting script into a user manual.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the innovation of using AI to repurpose test scripts as documentation
